definitions.explanation: All matters and aspects of a given situation. Most commonly used in the expression 準備万端 (fully prepared), meaning everything is ready.

examples.japanese: ⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧{万端|ばんたん}だ。
⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧{万端|ばんたん}⟦{整|ととの}えて→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}した→出発する：01832_shuppatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: We set off with everything fully prepared.

examples.japanese: {式|しき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{万端|ばんたん}{抜|ぬ}かり⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{進|すす}めている→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: Preparations for the ceremony are proceeding thoroughly without any oversights.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always appears in the expression ⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧{万端|ばんたん} (fully prepared, all preparations complete). Can also appear with ⟦{整|ととの}える→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧ (to arrange, to put in order). A somewhat formal expression conveying thoroughness and completeness.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧{万端|ばんたん} (fully prepared)
- {万端|ばんたん}⟦{整|ととの}う→整う：03935_totonou⟧ (everything is in order)
- {万端|ばんたん}{抜|ぬ}かり⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (thorough without any oversights)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{万全|ばんぜん}→万全：05932_banzen⟧: perfect, complete — used in ⟦{万全|ばんぜん}→万全：05932_banzen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{態勢|たいせい}→態勢：12937_taisei⟧ (perfect readiness)
- ⟦{完璧|かんぺき}→完璧：09505_kanpeki⟧: perfect — emphasizes flawlessness
